title: Hyundai USA owners - NACS adapter FAQs
notes: Hyundai EVs with native CCS ports get NACS adapters; the 2025 IONIQ 5 is the first Hyundai with a native NACS port (complimentary CCS adapter); the IONIQ 5 N does not have a native NACS port; works at Tesla V3/V4 Superchargers, 125 kW max at the time.
